works.author: Nixtio
works.comment: 卫星地图 + 附近站点卡 + 骑行记录，地图类产品的三段式布局很干净。
works.comment_en: Satellite map plus nearby-station cards plus ride history — a clean three-part layout for map products.
works.title: Bike Rental Web App Dashboard Design

works.author: Phenomenon Labs for Phenomenon Studio
works.comment: 紫色双色调统一图片与图标，硬核基建题材也能做得克制干净。
works.comment_en: A purple duotone unifies imagery and icons — proof that hardcore infrastructure topics can stay restrained and clean.
works.title: Website Design for Infrastructure Company – Krios

works.author: AmazingUI
works.comment: 生鲜按斤称重的步进器设计很细，底部悬浮购物车收尾干净。
works.comment_en: The by-weight stepper for fresh produce is finely detailed, and the floating bottom cart wraps it up cleanly.
works.title: Agentic AI App - Ordering Groceries

works.author: Visumind Creative
works.comment: 植物护肤 DTC：大字衬线标题 + 功效数据卡，优雅又带转化。
works.comment_en: Botanical skincare DTC: big serif headlines plus benefit data cards — elegant and conversion-minded.
works.title: Skincare E-commerce Website

works.author: Alamin Hossen
works.comment: 雾林视觉 + 柔和绿调的 Tiimo 规划工具落地页，氛围感做法值得抄。
works.comment_en: Tiimo planner landing page in misty-forest visuals and soft greens — the atmosphere craft is worth stealing.
works.title: AI Planner Website UI/UX Design

works.author: Purrweb UI/UX Agency
works.comment: 暗黑钓鱼预报 App：峰值时段仪表盘 + 钓点评分，小众垂直类 App 的数据可视化参考。
works.comment_en: Dark fishing-forecast app: peak-hour dashboard plus spot ratings — a data-viz reference for niche vertical apps.
works.title: Fishing Forecast Mobile iOS App Design
